en.headline: Five-year-old with chronic illness in serious condition after influenza A
en.dek: The boy developed fever, cough and shortness of breath on Sunday and is being treated in the paediatric intensive care unit at Queen Mary Hospital.
body: The Centre for Health Protection reported a severe paediatric influenza A case involving a five-year-old boy with a chronic illness who remains in serious condition in the paediatric intensive care unit at Queen Mary Hospital.

The child developed fever, cough and shortness of breath on 30 August and was taken to a private hospital the same day. He was transferred to Queen Mary Hospital because of breathing difficulties. Respiratory samples tested positive for influenza A virus, with a clinical diagnosis of severe pneumonia.

Preliminary investigation found no travel history during the incubation period. One household contact had mild upper respiratory symptoms and did not require hospital admission. The centre said influenza activity remained high and expected it to stay elevated in the early weeks of the school year, urging schools and parents to take preventive measures and to arrange vaccination when the 2026-27 programmes open on 17 September.

zh.headline: 5歲長期病患男童染甲流併發嚴重肺炎 情況嚴重
zh.dek: 男童周日起發燒咳嗽氣促，現於瑪麗醫院兒童深切治療部留醫；防護中心料開學初期流感仍活躍。
body: 衞生防護中心公布一宗兒童感染甲型流感嚴重個案，涉及一名有長期病患的5歲男童，目前在瑪麗醫院兒童深切治療部留醫，情況嚴重。
男童自8月30日起出現發燒、咳嗽及氣促，同日到私家醫院求醫，其後因呼吸困難轉送瑪麗醫院。呼吸道樣本對甲型流感病毒呈陽性，臨床診斷為甲型流感併發嚴重肺炎。
初步調查顯示男童潛伏期內無外遊，一名家居接觸者近日有輕微上呼吸道症狀，毋須入院。中心指流感活躍程度仍處高水平，預料開學初期仍會持續活躍，學校或現爆發，呼籲學校及家長提高警惕，並於9月17日接種計劃展開後盡早接種疫苗。
